Parable is enterprise intelligence purpose-built for leaders

company.description:
Executives have perfect visibility into financial allocation and zero visibility into time allocation. That's the problem behind 95% of AI transformation failures.

Parable is building Enterprise Intelligence - the operational measurement infrastructure that gives organizations the same clarity on time that they have on money. We aggregate workplace data, decode collective patterns with AI, and answer the strategic questions executives can't answer today: Do we have the time budget to execute these five priorities? Which AI pilots create real value? Where is operational debt hiding?

Founded in 2024 when we realized companies were spending billions on AI transformation while flying completely blind on their most expensive resource. We saw an opportunity to build the foundational system enterprises actually need—not another point solution, but the measurement layer that makes all transformation work.

We've raised $17M to build what every Fortune 1000 company will eventually have: an aggregated operational database. The question isn't whether this exists, but whether it's built with transparency, security, and strategic intention.

Not surveillance. Not productivity tracking. Aggregate insights only. Single-tenant architecture. Bank-level security. Your data stays in your dedicated private cloud.

The companies that win in the next decade won't be those with the most AI tools. They'll be those with operational clarity about what to automate, what to reimagine, and where to focus their most precious resource.
